pages.title: Place a Source
pages.text: A full bucket of a mod fluid can place its source and preserve the batch attributes. Refill a bucket from a source before switching brews. These fluids follow their own flow and source rules.

pages.title: Water-Like Fluids
pages.text: Most drink fluids behave like water for swimming, boats and hydration. Some dense or injectable fluids behave differently. Custom water-like sources can work with a conduit under the normal structure rules.
